documentation: Diff-gate manifest for packages/contracts/src/test/** at base commit 025133dbeec3d2aed32e335a55cde2853ee3fc12 (the tip of origin/feat/1004-protocol-dual-ledger this branch sits on -- NOT main, whose submit-tx.test.ts / find-deployed-contract.test.ts / test-mocks.ts were already rewritten by a later, unrelated integration). The 25 .ts files under packages/contracts/src/test/** at that commit split into three buckets by import content: untouchedFiles (this manifest's keyed entries): a file whose own import list does NOT name FinalizedTxData, VersionedFinalizedTxData, VersionedTx, unwrapV9, requireV9, or requireV9Record, and does NOT import from ./test-mocks or ../test-mocks. These 5 files must stay byte-identical while this phase adds era dispatch around the version-tagged provider seams described in docs/adr/0006-version-tagged-payloads-at-provider-seams.md; the sha256 below is the sole enforcement, and non-regression-baseline-gate.test.ts RE-DERIVES the classification from each file's own imports at runtime rather than trusting this list, so editing this manifest alone cannot move a file out of this bucket. versionedSeamTouchingFiles (listed for documentation only -- NOT hashed, because this phase is expected to change them): a file whose import list names one of those six identifiers, OR that imports from ./test-mocks / ../test-mocks (the provider mocks this phase touches). test-mocks.ts itself is included here by an explicit ruling, even though it cannot import itself: it is not a *.test.ts file, but it IS a behavioural fixture this phase touches. excludedFiles: resources/compiled/shielded-map/contract/index.d.ts is generated compiler output, not a behavioural test file, and is excluded from both buckets. goldenFixtureInputHashes (a separate section, not a behavioural-test bucket): the two non-.ts inputs the Step 2 golden fixture (resources/golden/v9-native-composition.json) depends on -- the compiled shielded-map contract and its deposit verifier key. Neither is a behavioural test file, so neither belongs in untouchedFiles or versionedSeamTouchingFiles, but both must stay byte-identical or the golden-fixture stages fail for the wrong reason (an unhashed input moved, not a composition regression). non-regression-golden.test.ts hashes these directly. postBaselineFiles: every packages/contracts/src/test/** .ts file added AFTER the base commit, declared here by name. None existed at the base commit, so none is walked into untouchedFiles or versionedSeamTouchingFiles, and the gate test skips exactly these when it re-derives the buckets. Declared, never auto-ignored: an UNDECLARED new file must still fail the classification tests, and that exhaustiveness is the whole point of the mechanism. These files are deliberately NOT hash-pinned -- the byte-lock exists to prove PRE-EXISTING tests were not perturbed, and a file that did not exist at the base commit has nothing to be unperturbed against. Every task that adds a test file under packages/contracts/src/test/** adds it to this array in the same commit. When the untouchedFiles gate legitimately fires (an intended change to one of those 5 files), the fix is to re-baseline: regenerate the sha256 values below and land that as its own, dedicated, no-production-change commit -- never edit the gate test to skip or weaken the check. When the goldenFixtureInputHashes gate fires, first check whether the contract was legitimately recompiled (re-baseline if so) before assuming a golden-stage failure is a composition regression. The baseCommit below is 025133db and stays 025133db even as this branch's own base moves on: it is the commit the pre-existing current-era tests were CAPTURED at, which is what the sha256 values are hashes of. It is not a record of where the branch is rooted, so do not "correct" it to whatever the branch currently sits on -- doing that would invalidate every hash in untouchedFiles without changing a single file.
classificationRule: versioned-seam-touching = the file's own import list names any of: FinalizedTxData, VersionedFinalizedTxData, VersionedTx, unwrapV9, requireV9, requireV9Record, or it imports from ./test-mocks / ../test-mocks (the provider mocks). Everything else (other than the excluded generated .d.ts) is untouched. non-regression-baseline-gate.test.ts re-derives this rule at runtime from each file's own import text -- this manifest's versionedSeamTouchingFiles list is checked against that re-derivation, not trusted as ground truth.
